video.title: The Ace Combat 8 Wings of Theve System Requirements are ABSOLUTELY INSANE

protocol.status: v2 labeler B (rubric v2), independent of A
protocol.note: Drafted from the transcript alone, without seeing any jevcut output or other labels.
protocol.times_from: Lemonfox transcript; seconds in the source, so labels survive re-transcription

clips.why: Hot take: 'PC system requirements are damn near a useless metric to assess how a PC game performs' -- no uniform tiers, devs don't test ('throw something at the wall, they'll figure it out on launch day'), then the proof: Danganronpa 2x2 lists an RTX 4070, 'that is a damn PSP game'. Preferred end on 'no reason why Danganronpa requires an RTX 4070' (85.6). Two other edges work: the 'they'll figure it out on launch day' joke (71.2) as the shortest, or after the Rayman 4080 example and 'there's actually no rhyme or reason' (99.0).

Take: 'I've been talking about two tiers of system requirements being stupid for a decade', and it's worse now with DLSS, frame gen and high-refresh players, so 'system requirements have literally regressed from a decade ago.' Opens on the decade line (or a beat earlier on 'having two tiers of system requirements is so stupid', 421.2, dropping the 'that's why' that points back). Lands on the regressed-because-DLSS-and-frame-gen line.

also_ok.why: Argument: why is medium settings upscaled to 1080p the recommended standard? Steam charts say most people are on 1080p, but a core game like Ace Combat targets players with better hardware, so recommended should be medium upscaled to 1440p. Coherent point but leans on the specs read earlier.

negatives.why: Intro teaser: 'the most insane system requirements I've ever seen' with no specs or reasoning yet.
Minimum requirements read off the screen (i7 10700K, 2060, 1080p upscaled 30fps low) with a side note on console optimization.
Recommended requirements read aloud ('32 gigs', RTX 3070, 1080p upscaled, 60fps medium) with outrage; energetic but the point is the spec sheet on screen.
Closing restatement: 'these requirements are absurd... a 3070 playing at toaster resolutions'; punchy but 'these' points back to the spec sheet.
Post-outro rant ('clown show requirements', Control fake early access, 'vomit-inducing') restating the video's point with an inside reference.
Post-roll call to hit the bell notification.
